title: Winners for Shibby's Holiday Toy Giveaway (ORIGINAL)
description: Entry to my Holiday Toy Giveaway has now ended. Thank you to everyone who entered the competition and sent lovely messages. The entries were drawn at random using an RNG. Fortunately all bar one of the entrants were able to receive their first choice toy. Emails have been sent out so you can send me your delivery information and get the toys well in time for Christmas. Winners are as follows: Kevin - Shibby Chastity Training Kit Matthew - The Most Wanted Bundle Jacob - Handy Cara - Lovense HowDee - Lovense Ollie - Lovense Keigo - Classic Shibby Chastity Cage Thomas - Lovense Jackson - Lovense Daniel - Classic Shibby Chastity Cage Jamie - Lovense Liva - The Oh (Aliases have been used in a couple of instances to preserve anonymity) Once again. congratulations to all the winners, I hope you were one of the lucky ones and thank you to everyone who participated. The giveaway had well over a thousand entries within the first day which is pretty crazy. I hope everyone had a fantastic Thanksgiving and am wishing you all a very Merry Christmas.
author: Mistress Shibby
